AIA Agentic AI ENGINEER
The opportunity
We are seeking a dynamic Senior consultant to join our AI Data Consulting team, focused on driving data-driven transformations . The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of AI strategy consulting, data enterprise data assessments and hands-on collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and impactful solutions.
You will work closely with C-suite leaders, operating partners, and portfolio company executives to help them leverage Agentic AI, Mistral LLM ecosystem (including Studio, Vibe, and Forge) , analytics, and data-driven platforms to unlock value, accelerate digital transformation, and create competitive advantage.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence:
AI Data Consulting for Private Equity
Partner with Operating Partners and leadership teams to define and execute Agentic AI, GenAI, and analytics-driven strategies leveraging modern LLM ecosystems including Mistral AI.
Develop and deploy AI implementation playbooks , frameworks, and accelerators incorporating Mistral models and agent-based architectures to drive tangible value creation.
Assess technology cost optimization , data monetization , and digital transformation opportunities across portfolio companies.
AI Ready Data Enterprise Data Assessments
Assess whether data is clean, secure, well structured, and ready for AI i.e.: AI-readiness evaluation (quality, lineage, security, architecture)
Review existing enterprise data to identify gaps and issues and evaluate the strength of data foundations across ERP and core systems
Define clear, prioritized actions to fix gaps and enable Mistral-powered AI use cases
Apply assessments during diligence, post merger integration, and 100 day plans
AI Digital Transformation
Design Agentic driven initiatives , translating business and functional requirements into agent architectures, workflows, and capabilities using platforms such as Mistral Studio and Vibe.
Build proprietary AI/ML accelerators leveraging Mistral LLMs (e.g., Mistral Large, Codestral, Pixtral) to enhance business processes such as customer care, software development, predictive analytics, and operational automation.
Develop and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines integrating enterprise data with Mistral models and enterprise AI platforms such as Mistral Forge .
Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI, LLMs, process mining, and advanced analytics to deliver cutting-edge solutions.
Familiarity with process mining tools like Celonis, Signavio, or PAFnow.
Proficiency with Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, semantic kernels, Autogen)
Proficiency in Python and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Understanding of basic data structures and algorithms
Working knowledge of: REST APIs, JSON, Async workflows
Data Analytics Strategy
Design and implement data solutions leveraging cloud platforms, data engineering frameworks, and predictive analytics models integrated with LLM platforms such as Mistral AI to solve complex business challenges.
Develop and Deploy data governance and quality frameworks , data marketplaces and analytics dashboards .
Expertise in designing, implementing, and maintaining Master Data Management (MDM) solutions to ensure data consistency, accuracy, and governance across enterprise systems.
Strong understanding of Cloud platforms (Azure / AWS / GCP), data visualization tools , and analytics solutions .
Exposure to ERP transformations (e.g., Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle) and portfolio tech integrations is a plus.
Team Leadership Collaboration
Work with cross -functional teams across consulting, product development, and data engineering to refine requirements
Foster collaboration between AI product teams, analytics experts, and sector specialists to deliver integrated , end-to-end AI solutions leveraging Mistral ecosystem capabilities .
Drive knowledge sharing and capability-building within the team.
Provide technical expertise during strategy execution, POCs, and architectural decisions
Skills and Attributes:
Educational Background
MBA / PGDM / master s degree in data science , AI, Analytics, or Business Management . Engineering or quantitative background preferred.
Professional Experience
5 to 10 years of experience in Agentic AI, digital transformation

jobs.job_title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer / AI Solutions Architect
jobs.job_description:
6–10 years of technology consulting/software development experience with 3+ years in AI/ML, GenAI, or LLM-based solutions
Strong experience in Prompt Engineering and AI Agent development
Hands-on expertise with LangGraph,LangChain, or Semantic Kernel

Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Architect / Led to lead the development of complex, multi-agent systems. Unlike standard "stateless" chatbots, our goal is to build autonomous digital partners that can perform multi-step research, execute code, and self-correct..

Key Responsibilities

Autonomous System Design: Architect multi-agent workflows using Claude and other LLMs that can decompose tasks and adapt to dynamic environments.

Backend Orchestration: Develop scalable services in Python (using FastAPI or Flask) and Java (Spring Boot) to coordinate agent roles, memory systems, and tool invocations.

Tool Integration: Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) and function calling to allow agents to interact with external APIs, databases, and enterprise systems.

Prompt Engineering: Create structured reasoning chains (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, ReAct) to steer agent behavior and ensure reliable outputs.

Observability & Safety: Build guardrails for agent behavior and implement tracing to monitor non-deterministic AI systems

Programming Languages:
Python: Expert level for AI logic, orchestration, and data handling.
Java: Strong experience for building enterprise-grade backend services and integrating AI into legacy systems.
LLM Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of Anthropic's Claude API and toolchains like Claude Code for development workflows.
Experience: Typically 3+ years in software or AI Architect, with at least 2 year dedicated to agentic systems..

Collaborate with AI Solution Lead and SMEs to convert business cases into technical designs.

Proficiency in Python and API development.
Experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel).
Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Mistral APIs.
Hands-on experience with RAG, vector databases, and embeddings.
Experience integrating AI with ERP (Oracle, SAP) or finance data systems.
Familiarity with automation tools like UiPath, Power Automate, or n8n.
Knowledge of GitHub Actions, Docker, or cloud-based deployment.

37 years in AI, automation, or software development.
Experience building GenAI applications for enterprise operations.
Exposure to ITSM, AMS, or Finance Managed Services environments.

B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or AI specialization.

About the Team / Organization

Outscale Partners is a fully owned subsidiary of The Argenbright Group and was established in 2022. The group brings more than 45 years of experience in transforming labor-intensive, essential frontline services across industries. It has operations across the United States, the United Kingdom, Middle East and India, supporting clients through a strong combination of industry expertise, technology, and people-centric service models. Outscale Partners focuses on delivering innovative workforce and service solutions that enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.




Work Mode - Permanent Remote

Shift Timings - 3.00 PM to 12.00 AM

5 days working (Mon to Fri)




Role & responsibilities

Build and integrate AI-driven capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows using leading LLM platforms.
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to enable AI systems to securely leverage internal knowledge and data sources.
Develop and orchestrate AI agents capable of executing multi-step, decision-based business processes.
Own production AI systems end-to-end, including deployment, versioning, monitoring, scaling, and cost optimization.
Define, implement, and maintain evaluation metrics for AI quality, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate closely with Leadership, Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact AI solutions.
Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data privacy, reliability, and maintainability.



Preferred candidate profile

7 to 8 years of overall software engineering experience, with 3 to 4 years of hands-on work on production AI / LLM systems.
Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing production-quality, testable, and maintainable code.
Proven experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, FAISS, ChromaDb, or similar).
Practical experience using LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Autogen, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel.
Prior experience building AI solutions in SaaS or enterprise-scale software environments.
Experience integrating with major LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini.
Solid understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering (context window management), and output control techniques.
Experience deploying AI systems to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using Docker and Kubernetes.
Working knowledge of LLMOps & MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and rollback strategies.
Experience in implementing guardrails in AI Solutions along with Observability.
